Owner + supplier login works (201 on /api/auth/login), /orders lists ORD-2026-000001 in READY_FOR_DISPATCH, owner order detail renders all panels (Lifecycle, Lines qty 40, Supplier allocations SAL-2026-000001 CONFIRMED PACKED lots de03824e…×40.000, Pack records PCK-2026-000001, Shipments create form with mode + temp-controlled), supplier /supply/orders shows the confirmed allocation, /supply/lots shows the seeded lot (avail 50, alloc 40, packed 40), supplier order detail correctly renders ONLY the supplier slice ('supplier view (own allocation only)' — no Lifecycle, no Lines, no ₹1,200 total; supplier's own ₹30/unit still shown as expected). rca of the issue: Original login blocker RCA (already fixed by main agent): pod restart wiped ephemeral PG/Redis (outside /app), and the legacy Emergent template FastAPI+CRA supervisor programs grabbed :8001/:3000 so florasetu-api hit EADDRINUSE and requests were served by FastAPI, returning {"detail":"Not Found"} on /api/auth/login. Mitigation: /app/scripts/bootstrap-infra.sh stops the rogue programs, restarts Postgres+Redis, runs migrations, and re-registers florasetu-api. Verified today by curl (owner+supplier login 201) and by end-to-end UI walkthrough.
